label: TPCx-IoT logical-record baseline ported to Cassandra
source_clause: Clause 2.2: driver system id, sensor name, timestamp, sensor reading, padding
qualification: The official TPCx-IoT is technology-agnostic and has database-specific bindings. This is a new Cassandra implementation of the specified flat logical record, not an official TPC Cassandra binding or canonical physical schema.
schema_cql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS b_tpcx_logical_raw (driver_system_id text, sensor_name text, event_ts bigint, event_id uuid, sensor_reading double, padding text, PRIMARY KEY ((sensor_name), event_ts, driver_system_id, event_id)) WITH CLUSTERING ORDER BY (event_ts ASC, driver_system_id ASC, event_id ASC);
limitations: Unbounded partition growth by sensor: requires scale feasibility assessment.
Event ID is a study-specific surrogate to preserve equal-timestamp multiplicity.
No official Cassandra-specific original schema exists in the referenced TPC specification.
Not selected through SchemaLens; measured only after HBench is frozen.
